info.description: The Loyalty Partners Retrieval API allows users to access information about loyalty partners within the loyalty program. This endpoint supports requests to retrieve detailed profiles of various partners, including their offerings and benefits available to loyalty program members. Typical consumers include mobile app developers, CRM systems, and marketing teams looking to enhance customer engagement through loyalty initiatives. By integrating this API, organizations can effectively leverage partner information to provide tailored experiences for their users.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of loyalty partners.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current list of loyalty partners available in the system. It returns detailed information about each partner, which can be used for various loyalty programs.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving loyalty partner information. This request allows clients to query details about available loyalty partners, which can include various attributes such as partner ID, name, and program details.
